opening.argument: The material begins by soliciting participation in Forsage for a stated payment: “For only 200 TRX (400pesos)to be participants!” The dashboard then supplies the mechanisms for recruitment, including an “Invite a partner” control and an affiliate-link section, while its legend maps personal partners, overflow relationships, and partners ahead of their parent within a structured matrix. Alongside the presented participation and earnings figures, these features describe an active multi-level earning arrangement built around partner invitations and tiered positions. The material therefore encourages recruitment-based participation in that structure, rather than merely reporting on or criticizing it.
